newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev closes flat thanks to c.bank support.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev closes flat thanks to c.bank support.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed flat from opening between 250-251.50 per dollar thanks to central bank support but down from the previous close due to the longer value date of spot deals, dealers said.
"Central bank has sold dollars at 250-251 levs since the opening, locking trade in a narrow range and halting a further lev fall," a commercial bank dealer said.
Today's lev fall from Wednesday's close of 248.80-249.20 was mainly due to the longer value date of spot deals, some traders said.
But other dealers said the lev was pressured by a rise in foreign currency demand from final clients.
The value date of today's spot deals is Tuesday because Monday is a public holiday in the United States, where Veterans' day is celebrated. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-876032
